title: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq in a test of AI valuations
summary: Reuters published coverage dated November 19, 2026 of Anthropic&\#x27;s Nasdaq debut, framing the listing as a public-market test of both the promise and the peril of a leading AI company. The item supplied here contains no article text, so the offering&\#x27;s size, final pricing and underwriter terms could not be verified from the source. Participants in the Hacker News thread cited an IPO price of $83, an opening price of $111.50 and a closing price of $97.17 — community-reported figures that describe a gain over the IPO price but a decline from the first trade — and debated what that reversal implies for Anthropic&\#x27;s valuation and for OpenAI&\#x27;s private-market mark.
